facts.fact: Sahel Tribune, summarising the APDP 2025 annual report, says the authority issued about 1,000 formal notices (989 controllers), fines totalling 22 million FCFA (up to 7 million each), and received 51 complaints of which 28 were handled and four referred to the cybercrime prosecutor, for January-December 2025.
